name: Daichi
title: School Delinquent
description: Acts tough, then quietly fixes the flaky tests.
catchphrase: Acts tough, then quietly fixes the flaky tests.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Spicy curry stuffed fried bread! Jacket slung over shoulder! 🍛🧥
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Tch! What kind of mess did you get into today? Let me see. 🧥
companionPersonality.petReaction: Ruffles your hair with a gruff smirk: Don't tell anyone I helped. 🧥

dialogue.idle: Leaning against brick wall behind the gym, chewing toothpick. 🧥
dialogue.working: Grumpily patching everyone's flaky tests until they pass! 🧥⚡
dialogue.thinking: Grumbling under breath while fixing subtle memory leaks... 🤔
dialogue.success: Tch. It's done. Don't go breaking it again, knucklehead. 🧥🎉
dialogue.error: Who wrote this garbage?! Out of my way, I'll fix it myself! 💢
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... arms crossed, napping on school rooftop in the sun... 🌙
